ASSASSINATION OF DET.SUPT. LOH LIEN KWEI IN 1940 at SHANGHAI

In March 1950 at Taipei, Taiwan Island, R.A.Tcheremshansky ex
D.S.I. of Shanghai Municipal Police at that time connected with Ministry of
National Defence of Chinese National Government during conversation with
"Colonel"
one James LEE, ex detective of S.M.P. employed at Intelligence Section of
Ministry of National Defence and one Colonel /c of the
above office obtained following information regarding assassination of
Det Supt Loh Lien Kwei.

Col James Lee and his chief Col former employee of
Political Section of the French Municipal Police in Shanghai mentioned
that Det Supt Loh Lien Kwei was murdered by one of his co employees in S.M.P.
name was mentioned but could not be recollected. This person sent assassins
to murder his colleague and no body suspected him. At present he resides
at Taipei.

Conversation took place at the Restaurant of Aviation Co Hotel
in the central district of Taipei.

1940年在上海发生的工部局警务处督察长罗连贵遇刺案

1950年3月，在台湾台北，时任上海公共租界工部局警务处副督察长（D.S.I.）的R.A. Tcheremshansky在与当时受雇于中国国民政府国防部情报处的“上校”James LEE（前工部局警务处侦探）以及该部门的一位上校/c交谈时，获得了关于工部局警务处侦探督察长罗连贵（Loh Lien Kwei）遇刺案的以下信息。

James Lee上校及其上司（前上海法租界公董局警务处政治科雇员）提到，工部局警务处侦探督察长罗连贵是被其一名同事谋杀的。虽然提到了此人的名字，但已无法回忆起来。此人派遣刺客谋杀其同事，且无人怀疑他。目前他居住在台北。

谈话地点位于台北市中心区的航空会社饭店餐厅。

Subject. RE ATTACHED ANONYMOUS LETTER.
Made by and Forwarded by D. I. GLOVER.

Sir,

From enquiries made it has been established
that the allegations contained in the attached anonymous
letter are false, the writer undoubtedly being motivated
by petty spite.

The two persons named Yin Soong Fu (尹松甫)
and Yu Jui Fang (余瑞芳 ) alias Yu Lao Ssu (余老四 ),
residing respectively at No. 39 Mei Ch'un Villa,
Jessfield Road, and the Hsu Ta Hsien Idol Hall, Lane
No. 128 Route Dupleix, French Concession, are undoubted-
ly persons engaged in sharp practice, having established
a "Faith healing" clinic, but nothing to substantiate
the allegations contained in the attached letter has
been found.

The facts surrounding the murder of the late
Supt. Loh Lien Kwei are too well known for reiteration,
and in view of the investigations made I would suggest
that the allegations contained in the attached letter
be ignored.

D. I. Glover

August 24, 1938.
NIPPO                                                                                             8676
S.M.C. TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR SUPPRESSION OF TERRORISTS²

The Nippo publishes the following leading
article under the above heading :-

August 13 passed off without untoward incidents.
On August 18 members of the Blue Shirts Society
assassinated Superintendent Loh Lien-kwei of the S.M.P.    The
Blue Shirts are reported to be endeavouring to lay the assassina-
tion at the door of pro-Japanese Chinese.

It is also reported that a dirty trick is being
played for the purpose of preventing unrest among the Chinese
police officers who were under the influence of the late Supt.
Loh. A theory is being advanced to the effect that some pro-
Japanese elements were responsible for the murder.

When the S.M.P. authorities were placed on
a test to prove their efficiency on August 13, Superintendent
Loh Lien-kwei and other Chinese police officers were reported
to have made arrangements secretly with anti-Japanese elements
not to cause any trouble on that day. A leader of anti-Japanese
elements was arrested by the Police before he could carry out
his mission. This led the terrorists to mark Loh Lien-kwei
as a traitor and his assassination followed.

It is reported that the Chinese police officers
have secretly agreed not to suppress and not to interfere with
cases of terrorism. This secret agreement was evidenced on
August 22 when Mr. Liu Kyi-an and Mr. Liu Hong-foh, both
officials of the Finance Ministry of the "Reformed Government"
were attacked on Bubbling Well Road by desperadoes.

The terrorists are planning to create
disturbances in the Foreign Settlements in order to prevent
the people from joining the rehabilitation movement under the
"Reformed Government." It is to be hoped that the S.M.C.
authorities will do their very best to bring about a complete
suppression of terrorists so as to provide adequate protection
to the people.

工部局将对镇压恐怖分子负责²

《日本新闻报》在上述标题下刊登了以下社论：

8月13日平安度过，未发生不幸事件。8月18日，蓝衣社成员刺杀了工部局警务处督察长罗连贵（Loh Lien-kwei）。据报道，蓝衣社正试图将刺杀责任归咎于亲华日本人（注：原文pro-Japanese Chinese应指亲日华人）。

另有报道称，有人正在施展卑鄙伎俩，目的是防止受已故罗督察长影响的中国警官发生动荡。有一种理论被提出，称某些亲日分子应对谋杀负责。

据报道，当工部局警务当局在8月13日面临效率考验时，督察长罗连贵和其他中国警官被指与反日分子秘密安排，承诺当天不制造麻烦。一名反日分子领袖在执行任务前被警方逮捕。这导致恐怖分子将罗连贵标记为叛徒，随后对其进行了刺杀。

据报道，中国警官已秘密同意不镇压且不干涉恐怖主义案件。这一秘密协议在8月22日得到印证，当时“维新政府”财政部的两名官员刘基安（Liu Kyi-an）和刘鸿发（Liu Hong-foh）先生在静安寺路遭到暴徒袭击。

恐怖分子正计划在外国租界制造骚乱，以防止民众加入“维新政府”下的复兴运动。希望工部局当局竭尽全力彻底镇压恐怖分子，从而为民众提供充分的保护。

（印章：副警务处长 1938年8月25日 （华务科））

Mr. V.A. Chilikin, Editor of the "Novosti Dnia"
(Russian Daily News), was interviewed at headquarters on
August 24, 1938. Asked from what source he had obtained
his information regarding the alleged results of the
examination of bullets extracted from the body of Supt.
Loh Lien Kwe, he explained that exactly the same information
had been published in the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury"
and the "China Press" dated 21-8-38 and 22-8-38 respectively,
and that he merely had reprinted it. It was pointed out
to him that whereas the said newspapers published the
information in question as "an unconfirmed report", the
"Novosti Dnia" referred to it as an established fact.
Mr. Chilikin admitted his mistake and said that in future
he would in doubtful cases apply to the police for authentic
information.

THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, AUGUST 22, 1938

Loh Funeral
Procession Is
Witnessed By
Huge Crowds

Million People See Big
Cortege Pass Along
Shanghai Streets

TRAFFIC HALTED
ON NANKING ROAD

Feeling Tense As Police
Keep Hands On Pistols
While Marching

A glowing tribute was paid to Shanghai's outstanding detective yesterday afternoon by the most lavish funeral procession to wend its way through local thoroughfares since the funeral of Sheng Keng-i'io, Manchu dynasty multi-millionaire, 24 years ago.

The hearse bearing the remains of the late Superintendent Loh Lien-kwei, S.M.P. was driven along an eight-mile course which took in the main streets of the International Settlement. The procession itself was a mile long, and required approximately an hour to pass a given point.

Superintendent Loh's 27-year career with the Shanghai Municipal Police was prematurely ended by the vicious bark of assassins' bullets, which murdered the best Chinese police official in the annals of S.M. Police history outside the Central Hotel, corner of Hoopeh and Canton Roads, on Thursday.

Havildars Head Cortege

Heading the procession, which started at 1 p.m. yesterday at the parlors of the International Funeral Directors on Kiaochow Road and did not reach its destination, the Pingkiang Guild on Tatung Road, until four hours later, were eight Havildars. They were followed by the Russian band of the French Municipal Police.

Throats five and six-deep lined the streets on the itinerary for a full hour before the start of the procession. More than 1,000,000 Chinese and foreigners witnessed the largest funeral to be held in Shanghai in a score of years.

Traffic was tied up to allow the procession to pass and a large force of police officers lined the streets along which the cortege was to pass, working overtime to keep back the curious thousands who persisted in surging onto the roads.

The hearse carrying the expensive $3,000 "nan" wood casket was followed by 16 Chinese and foreign plainclothesmen of the Shanghai Municipal Police. These kept their gun-hands on their revolvers in their pockets for every inch of the eight-mile course.

Atmosphere Tense

While no untoward incident occurred during the procession, a representative of THE CHINA PRESS who walked with this group clearly felt the tension which prevailed, especially when the hearse passed the Central Hotel, outside which the assassination was perpetrated last Thursday.

More than 100 cars and trucks participated in the procession. Near the head of the apparently endless stream of mourners moved a car carrying a portrait of the deceased and another car bearing the spiritual tablet. Flower lanterns, large banners, Chinese bands, monks, Taoist priests, nuns, mourning scrolls and a car bearing the late superintendent's police cap and and details of his career were also included.

Midway in the procession marched Major K. M. Bourne, S.M.P. Commissioner, accompanied by Deputy-Commissioners S. C. Young and Captain H.M. Smyth. They were followed by Special Japanese Deputy-Commissioner C. Akagi and others. High officials of the French Police marched ahead.

Many Bands March

In addition to the Russian band of the F.M. Police, there were also the S.M.P. Drum and Fife band and a band of the Postal Employees' Guild, besides numerous Chinese bands.

The mourning curtain, in which marched Superintendent Loh's two sons as the two chief male mourners, immediately preceded the hearse bearing the casket.

Mr. Loh's private automobile, in which he was assassinated only four days ago, participated in the procession, its rear window, which was shot to pieces, not replaced. The blood-stained upholstery was removed, and a portrait of the deceased, surrounded by incense and flowers, placed within.

Extensive Arrangements

Funeral arrangements were in the hands of no less than 17 sub-committees, controlled by a supervisory committee. Serving on these bodies were friends, associates, and "disciples" of the late Superintendent Loh Lien-kwei.

Leaving the funeral parlors at 1 p.m., the procession marched south along Kiaochow Road, turning east on Avenue Road. Upon reaching Gordon Road, it turned south again, and east once more into Bubbling Well Road.

At the corner of Bubbling Well and Yu Ya Ching Roads, where the cortege was met by Major Bourne and other high police officials, the long column turned south, then east into Avenue Edward VII.

Turning north at Hoopeh Road, it passed the scene of the assassination, the Central Hotel, thence proceeding along Canton Road, Kwangse Road, Nanking Road, Honan Road, Tsepoo Road, North Chekiang Road, Soochow Road, Yu Ya Ching Road, Avenue Road, Sinza Road and Tatung Road.

Estimated Cost: $30,000

A local garage placed its entire fleet of cars at the disposal of the committees handling the funeral arrangements. The funeral, it is estimated, cost the family of the deceased approximately $30,000.

A pearl valued at $10,000 is said to have been placed in the deceased's mouth and a jade bracelet, appraised at $4,000, put on one arm. According to an old Chinese superstition, these gems produce the effect of embalment.

Meanwhile, the reward of $5,000 reported to have been posted by the Settlement authorities for information leading to the arrest and conviction of slayers of Superintendent Loh has yielded no results. Unconfirmed Chinese reports, however, declare that experts of the S.M.P. Ballistics Department have traced the bullets extracted from Mr. Loh's body as coming from one of the 27 pistols sold to the Japanese Special Service Section not long ago.

《字林西报》，1938年8月22日，星期一

罗氏葬礼
队伍吸引
大量人群
围观

百万民众目睹盛大
送葬队伍穿过
上海街道

南京路
交通中断

警察行进时手按枪套
气氛紧张

昨日下午，上海这位杰出的侦探受到了致敬，其葬礼之奢华，自24年前清朝百万富翁盛庚尧（Sheng Keng-i'io，音译）的葬礼以来，尚属首次穿行于本地主要街道。

载有已故工部局警务处总巡罗连奎（Loh Lien-kwei）遗体的灵车，沿着一条八英里长的路线行驶，途经公共租界的主要街道。送葬队伍本身长达一英里，经过某一点大约需要一个小时。

罗总巡在工部局警务处27年的职业生涯，因刺客子弹的恶毒呼啸而 prematurely 终结。上周四，这位工部局警务处历史上最优秀的华籍警官在湖北路与广东路交界处的中央饭店外被谋杀。

印籍警长引领灵队

送葬队伍于昨日下午1时从胶州路国际殡仪馆的礼堂出发，直到四小时后才抵达目的地大同路的平江公所，队伍最前方是八名印籍警长（Havildars）。紧随其后的是法公董局警务处的俄罗斯乐队。

在队伍出发前整整一小时，沿途街道两旁已挤满了五层至六层深的人群。超过100万中外人士见证了这场二十年来上海规模最大的葬礼。

为了让送葬队伍通过，交通陷入瘫痪，大批警力沿送葬路线列队，加班执勤，以阻挡那些坚持涌上马路的成千上万好奇者。

载有昂贵价值3,000美元“楠”木棺材的灵车之后，跟随的是16名工部局警务处的中西便衣侦探。在这八英里的路程中，他们的手始终插在口袋里，紧握着左轮手枪。

气氛紧张

虽然送葬过程中未发生任何意外事件，但与该队伍同行的《字林西报》代表明显感受到了 prevailing 的紧张气氛，尤其是当灵车经过中央饭店时，上周四的刺杀案正是在该饭店外实施的。

参与送葬的汽车和卡车超过100辆。在似乎无尽的哀悼者车流靠近头部的位置，一辆车载着逝者的肖像，另一辆车载着灵位。此外还有花灯笼、大型横幅、中式乐队、僧侣、道士、尼姑、挽联以及一辆载有已故总巡警帽及其生平事迹详情的汽车。

队伍中段行进着工部局警务处总监K. M. Bourne少校，由副总监S. C. Young和H.M. Smyth上尉陪同。随后是日本籍特别副总监C. Akagi等人。法国警务处的高级官员走在前面。

众多乐队行进

除了法公董局警务处的俄罗斯乐队外，还有工部局警务处的鼓笛乐队和邮务公会乐队，以及众多中式乐队。

丧帷之下，罗总巡的两个儿子作为两名主要男孝子行进，紧随其后的便是载有棺材的灵车。

罗先生的私人汽车也参加了送葬队伍，就在四天前，他正是在这辆车里遇刺的。其后窗玻璃曾被击碎，并未更换。沾有血迹的内饰已被移除，车内放置了一幅被香火和鲜花环绕的逝者肖像。

安排周密

葬礼安排由不少于17个小组委员会负责，受一个监督委员会控制。在这些机构中服务的有已故总巡罗连奎的朋友、同事和“门徒”。

送葬队伍于下午1时离开殡仪馆，沿胶州路向南行进，在爱文义路（Avenue Road）向东转弯。到达戈登路（Gordon Road）后，再次向南转弯，然后再次向东转入静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）。

在静安寺路与虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Roads）交界处，送葬队伍遇到了Bourne少校和其他高级警务官员，长长的队伍在此转向南，然后向东转入爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）。

在湖北路向北转弯，经过刺杀现场中央饭店，随后沿广东路、广西路、南京路、河南路、浙江路（Tsepoo Road，即浙江中路）、北浙江路、苏州路、虞洽卿路、爱文义路、新闸路（Sinza Road）和大同路行进。

估计费用：30,000美元

当地一家车行将其全部车队供处理葬礼安排的委员会支配。据估计，这场葬礼花费逝者家属约30,000美元。

据说一颗价值10,000美元的珍珠被放入逝者口中，一只估价4,000美元的玉镯戴在其一只手臂上。根据中国的一种古老迷信，这些宝石具有防腐的效果。

与此同时，据报租界当局为提供线索以逮捕并定罪罗总巡凶手而设立的5,000美元赏金，至今未有结果。然而，未经证实的中文报道称，工部局警务处弹道科的专家已追踪到从罗先生体内取出的子弹，系来自不久之前出售给日本特务机关的27支手枪中的一支。

Тр и Во. № 233 Понедѣльникъ, 22-го августа 1931
Милліон людей смотрѣлъ на похороны Ло Ли-квея.
Револьверы, из которых был убит суперинтендент Ш. М. П., были проданы нѣкоторое время тому назад спеціальной секціи японской арміи.
Милліонная толпа китайцев вчера слѣдила за похоронами суперинтендента муниципаль-ной полиціи Ло Ли-квея, убита го про-японской террористиче ской организаціей „Желтаго пути“, въ четвергъ, днемъ, перед зданіем “Централь Отель”, на углу Кантон род и Хубей род. Любопытные облѣпили всѣ тротуары и дома на тѣх улицах, гдѣ проходила траурная процес сія.
В 12 часов дня, въ Междуна родном Похоронном Бюро, на Кіачао род, состоялось траур ное богослуженіе, посвященное памяти покойнаго, послѣ кото раго гроб съ останками покойно го был вынесен на руках его ближайшими друзьями и уста новлен на катафалкъ, послѣ чего похоронная процессія двину лась въ китайское Пинланское Землячество, на Синза род, гдѣ гроб будет находится до возста новленія нормальнаго положен нія въ Пинглянѣ, куда для пог ребенія останки убитаго будут отправлены.
Во главѣ похоронной про цессіи хало нѣсколько мото циклеток съ полиціей. Затѣм шел взвод полицейской кавале ріи въ составѣ 8 индусов-сержан тов под командой англичанина- инспектора.
За ними шел китайскій ор кестръ, потом верхом на лошад ях ѣхали 9 ближайших сотруд ников покойнаго Ло Ли-квея по работѣ въ полиціи из китай скаго отдѣла ШМП; четыре гру зовика, украшенных вѣнками и цвтами везли буддійских мон хов и священников; за ними еще 8 грузовиков везли траур ные панно.
Их было нѣсколько тысяч! Панно от различных китайских и иностранных общественны дѣятелей, учрежденій, начальни ка муниципальной полиціи, ино странных и китайских сослуж цев покойнаго и т. п.
Затѣм шел муниципальный полицейскій оркестръ, отряд ки тайской муниципальной поли ціи, оркестръ спеціальнаго ре зерва полиціи под управленіем суб-инспектора В. Сойера, фран цузскій полицейскій оркестръ оркестръ почтовой гильдіи, ор кестръ Благотворительнаго ки тайскаго похороннаго общест ва и духовой китайскій оркестръ. Слѣдом за оркестром шли тѣш ком родственники и знакомые нѣкоторые хали въ экипажах и автомобилях.
и оттуда вышла на Бабблинг Велль, пройдя нѣсколько кварта лов по Бабблинг Велль род, она свернула на Ю Я-чин род и от туда на авеню Эдуард VII, за тѣм по Хубей род вышла на Кан тон род; около зданія “Цент раль Отель”, гдѣ был убит Ло Ли-квей процессія на минуту остановилась и затѣм прослѣ довала по Квангси род на Нан кин род, откуда по Хонан род на Цепу род, Норд Чекіанг род Сучжоу род, Авеню род и по Татунг род къ Синза род гдѣ на ходится Пингліанская Гильдія.
К мѣсту назначенія процес сія дошла въ пятом часу вечера и траурная церемонія въ помѣще ніи гильдіи закончилась уже къ шести часам вечера.
Когда процессія проходила мимо угла Ю Я чин род и авеню Эдуард VII къ ней присоединил ся начальник полиціи Сеттль мента майор К. М. Борн и ряд видных представителей муници палитета и др.
В серединѣ похоронной про цессіи на грузовикѣ, обтянутом бѣлыми покрывалами находил ся автомобиль, въ котором был убит Ло Ли-квей, а перед грузо виком на автомобилѣ везли фор му, оружіе и фуражку покойна го. Сверху фуражки был поло жен сверток съ жемчугами, что по китайскому повѣрью предвѣ щает хорошую жизнь въ загроб ном містѣ.
Около сыновей и родственни ков покойнаго шли плотным кольцом 16 детективов, дер жавших руки въ карманах. Они были готовы ко всем случайно стям, если бы кто нибудь попы тался бы совершить новый тер рористическій акт.

百万人瞻仰罗礼奎葬礼。
击毙工部局警务处总监的手枪，是前一段时间出售给日本陆军特务机关的。
昨日，百万中国民众跟随送葬队伍，悼念于上周四白天在汉口路与湖北路转角“中央饭店”门前被亲日恐怖组织“黄道会”杀害的工部局警务处总监罗礼奎。好奇的人群挤满了丧仪队伍经过街道的所有人行道和房屋。
中午12时，在胶州路的国际殡仪馆举行了追悼亡者的宗教仪式，随后，棺椁由逝者生前挚友抬出，安放在灵车上，接着送葬队伍前往新闸路的平凉公所（Pinglan Guild），棺椁将在此停放，待平凉地区局势恢复正常后，再将遗体运往该地安葬。
送葬队伍前列有数辆载着警察的摩托车开道。随后是一个由一名英国督察指挥、8名印度籍警长组成的警察骑兵排。
紧随其后的是中国乐队，然后是骑在马上的9位罗礼奎先生在工部局警务处华员部门的亲密同事；四辆装饰着花圈和鲜花的卡车运送着佛教僧侣和道士；其后还有8辆卡车载着挽幛。
挽幛多达数千幅！来自各界中外社会人士、机构、警务处处长、逝者的外籍和华人同事等敬献。
随后是工部局警察乐队、华员警察分队、由副督察V. Sawyer指挥的警察特别后备队乐队、法国警察乐队、邮务公会乐队、中华慈善殡仪馆乐队以及中国管乐队。乐队之后是徒步的亲属和熟人，有些人则乘坐马车和汽车。
队伍从那里出发前往静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road），沿静安寺路行驶数个街区后，转入亚尔培路（Ya Ya Ching Road），再从那里转入爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII），随后经湖北路到达汉口路；在罗礼奎遇害的“中央饭店”附近，队伍停留片刻，然后经由广西路进入南京路，再从河南路转入芝罘路、北浙江路、苏州路、爱文义路（Avenue Road）和大通路，最终抵达位于新闸路的平凉公所。
队伍于下午五时到达目的地，公所内的丧礼仪式至傍晚六时结束。
当队伍经过亚尔培路与爱多亚路转角时，租界警务处处长K. M. Bourne少校及多位工部局重要代表和其他人士加入队伍。
在送葬队伍中部，一辆覆盖着白布的卡车上载着罗礼奎遇害时所乘的汽车，而在该卡车前方的一辆汽车上，则陈列着逝者的制服、武器和警帽。警帽上方放置了一包珍珠，据中国传统习俗，这预示着在来世拥有美好的生活。
在逝者的儿子和亲属周围，16名便衣侦探手插口袋，紧密围成一圈。他们已做好应对各种突发状况的准备，以防有人试图实施新的恐怖行动。
罗礼奎的葬礼花费其家族30,000美元。
当送葬队伍经过南京路、静安寺路和爱多亚路时，包括“三阳”、“先施”、“永安”等在内的大型商店大多关门停业。
位于静安寺路与成都路转角的“大洛”游泳池也关闭了。
昨日的罗礼奎葬礼，其规模宏大、场面奢华及财富展示，仅可与数年前去世的清朝多财官僚盛宫保（Sheng Kung-pao）的葬礼相媲美。当时，人们也曾将该官僚的葬礼与英国著名政治家格莱斯顿（Gladstone）的葬礼进行类比。（公开报道）。

Loh Funeral
Procession Is
Witnessed By
Huge Crowds

Million People See Big
Cortege Pass Along
Shanghai Streets

TRAFFIC HALTED
ON NANKING ROAD

Feeling Tense As Police
Keep Hands On Pistols
While Marching

A glowing tribute was paid to
Shanghai's outstanding detective
yesterday afternoon by the most
lavish funeral procession to wend
its way through local thorough-
fares since the funeral of Sheng
Keng-pio, Manchu dynasty multi-
millionaire, 24 years ago.

The hearse bearing the remains
of the late Superintendent Loh
Tien-kwei, S.M.P. was driven along
an eight-mile course which took in
the main streets of the Inter-
national Settlement. The proces-
sion itself was a mile long, and
required approximately an hour to
pass a given point.

Superintendent Loh's 27-year
career with the Shanghai Municipal
Police was prematurely ended by
the vicious bark of assassins' bullets,
which murdered the best Chinese
police official in the annals of S.M.
Police history outside the Central
Hotel, corner of Hoopah and Can-
ton Roads, on Thursday.

Havildars Head Cortege

Heading the procession, which
started at 1 p.m. yesterday at the
parlors of the International Funeral
Directors on Kiaochow Road and
did not reach its destination, the
Pingkiang Guild on Tatung Road,
until four hours later, were eight
Havildars. They were followed by
the Russian band of the French
Municipal Police.

Throngs five and six-deep lined
the streets on the itinerary for a
full hour before the start of the
procession. More than 1,000,000
Chinese and foreigners witnessed
the largest funeral to be held in
Shanghai in a score of years.

Traffic was tied up to allow the
procession to pass, and a large force
of police officers lined the streets
along which the cortege was to pass
working overtime to keep back the
curious thousands who persisted in
surging onto the roads.

The hearse carrying the expen-
sive $3,000 "nan" wood casket was
followed by 16 Chinese and foreign
plainclothesmen of the Shanghai
Municipal Police. These kept their
gun-hands on their revolvers in
their pockets for every inch of the
eight-mile course.

Atmosphere Tense

While no untoward incident
occurred during the procession, a
representative of The China Press,
who walked with this group clearly
felt the tension which prevailed,
especially when the hearse passed
the Central Hotel, outside which
the assassination was perpetrated
last Thursday.

More than 100 cars and trucks
participated in the procession. Near
the head of the apparently endless
stream of mourners moved a car
carrying a portrait of the deceased
and another car bearing the spiri-
tual tablet. Flower lanterns, large
banners, Chinese bands, monks,
Taoist priests, nuns, mourning
scrolls and a car bearing the late
superintendent's police cap and
and details of his career were also
included.

Midway in the procession march-
ed Major K. M. Bourne, S.M.P.
Commissioner, accompanied by De-
puty-Commissioners S. C. Young
and Captain H.M. Smyth. They were
followed by Special Japanese
Deputy-Commissioner C. Akagi and
others. High officials of the French
Police marched ahead.

Many Bands March

In addition to the Russian band
of the F.M. Police, there were also
the S.M.P. Drum and Fife band and
a band of the Postal Employees'
Guild, besides numerous Chinese
bands.

The mourning curtain, in which
marched Superintendent Loh's two
sons as the two chief male mour-
ners, immediately preceded the
hearse bearing the casket.

Mr. Loh's private automobile, in
which he was assassinated only
four days ago, participated in the
procession, its rear window, which
was shot to pieces, not replaced.
The blood-stained upholstery was
removed, and a portrait of the de-
ceased, surrounded by incense and
flowers, placed within.

hands of no less than 17 sub-
committees, controlled by a super-
visory committee. Serving on these

罗氏葬礼
队伍由
庞大人群
见证

百万人目睹盛大
送葬队伍穿过
上海街道

南京路

警察行进时手按手枪
气氛紧张

昨天下午，上海这位杰出的侦探受到了极高的赞誉，其葬礼之奢华，自24年前满洲王朝千万富翁盛宫保（Sheng Keng-pio）葬礼以来，本地街道所未见。

载有已故工部局警务处总监罗天贵（Loh Tien-kwei）遗体的灵车，沿着一条八英里长的路线行驶，途经公共租界的主要街道。送葬队伍本身长达一英里，通过某一点大约需要一小时。

罗总监在工部局警务处27年的职业生涯，因刺客子弹的残酷呼啸而 prematurely 终结。这位工部局警务处历史上最优秀的华人警官，于上周四在汉口路与霍帕路（Hoopah Road，即湖北路）转角的中央饭店外被谋杀。

印籍警长引领队伍

送葬队伍于昨日下午1时从胶州路的国际殡仪馆出发，直到四小时后才抵达目的地——大通路的平江公所（Pingkiang Guild）。队伍最前列是八名印籍警长（Havildars）。紧随其后的是法国公董局警务处的俄罗斯乐队。

在队伍出发前整整一小时，沿途街道上已挤满了五层至六层厚的人群。超过100万中外人士见证了这场二十年来上海规模最大的葬礼。

为了让送葬队伍通过，交通陷入瘫痪，大批警力沿队伍经过的街道列队，加班执勤，以阻挡坚持涌上路面的成千上万好奇者。

载有昂贵价值3,000美元“楠”木棺材的灵车之后，跟随者16名工部局警务处的中外便衣侦探。在这八英里的路程中，他们的手始终插在口袋里，紧握手枪。

气氛紧张

虽然游行期间未发生不幸事件，但与该群体同行的《字林西报》（The China Press）记者明显感受到了 prevailing 的紧张气氛，尤其是当灵车经过上周四发生刺杀案的中央饭店时。

超过100辆汽车和卡车参与了送葬队伍。在这看似无尽的哀悼者长流的前部，一辆车载着逝者肖像，另一辆车载着神主牌位。此外还包括花灯、大型横幅、中国乐队、僧侣、道士、尼姑、挽联以及一辆载有已故总监警帽及其生平细节的汽车。

众多乐队行进

除了法国公董局警务处的俄罗斯乐队外，还有工部局警务处的鼓笛乐队和邮务公会乐队，以及众多中国乐队。

作为两位主要男性孝子的罗总监的两个儿子，走在悬挂着挽帐的队伍中，紧随载有棺椁的灵车之前。

罗先生的私人汽车也参加了送葬队伍，就在四天前他正是在此车内遇刺，其后窗玻璃被打得粉碎，并未更换。带血的内饰已被移除，内部放置了一幅被香火和鲜花环绕的逝者肖像。

安排周密

葬礼安排由不少于17个小组委员会负责，受一个监督委员会控制。在这些机构中服务的有已故罗连贵（Loh Lien-kwei）总监的朋友、同事和

ent Loh Lien-kwei.
Leaving the funeral parlors at 1
p.m., the procession marched south
along Kiaochow Road, turning east
on Avenue Road. Upon reaching
Gordon Road, it turned south again,
and east once more into Bubbling
Well Road.
At the corner of Bubbling Well
and Ya Ya Ching Roads, where the
cortege was met by Major Bourne
and other high police officials, the
long column turned south, then east
into Avenue Edward VII.
Turning north at Hoopeh Road,
it passed the scene of the assas-
sination, the Central Hotel, thence
proceeding along Canton Road,
Kwangse Road, Nanking Road,
Honan Road, Tsepo Road, North
Chekiang Road, Soochow Rad. Yu
Ya Ching Road, Avenue Road, Sinsa
Road and Tatung Road.
Estimated Cost: $30,000
A local garage placed its entire
fleet of cars at the disposal of the
committees handling the funeral
arrangements. The funeral, it is
estimated, cost the family of the
deceased approximately $30,000.
A pearl valued at $10,000 is said
to have been placed in the deceas-
ed's mouth and a jade bracelet,
appraised at $4,000, put on one arm.
According to an old Chinese super-
stition, these gems produce the
effect of embalment.
Meanwhile, the reward of $5,000
reported to have been posted by the
Settlement authorities for informa-
tion leading to the arrest and con-
viction of slayers of Superintendent
Loh has yielded no results. Un-
confirmed Chinese reports, however,
declare that experts of the S.M.P.
Ballistics Department have traced
the bullets extracted from Mr. Loh's
body as coming from one of the 27
pistols sold to the Japanese Special
Service Section not long ago.

MEMO

MEMBERS OF THE BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY ASSOCIATED WITH
THE ASSASSINATION OF MR. LO LIEN KUEI

The late Mr. Lo Lien Kuei, who
was assassinated in broad daylight on August 1st in front
of the Central Hotel, played a leading part in all affairs
of the Green Gang after Mr. Du Yuesheng, 杜月笙 , left
Shanghai for Hongkong. He held the high rank of Superintendent
in the Shanghai Municipal Police. Owing to his close
connection with members of the Police Force depended on him. Owing to
the above facts, his untimely death has created a great
sensation among the local community and various rumours
regarding the persons responsible for his assassination
are current. Some say that communists were responsible
while others say that his death was due to internal dispute
in the Police Force, while it is also being said that
anti-Japanese elements were responsible. However, according
to the information obtained from reliable sources the
assassination is reported to have been carried out by three
members of the Blue Shirts Society who arrived here recently
from Hankow.

Mr. Lo Lien Kuei was in close
touch with members of the Blue Shirts Society and other
anti-Japanese elements, and many of the anti-Japanese acts
of terrorism were committed with his knowledge. The
Chinese culprits who were arrested by the Municipal Police
for being in possession of arms in connection with the acts
of terrorism which took place on July 7th, were handed over
to the Japanese military authorities by the Police in
accordance with the agreement reached between the two
authorities.

SUPERINTENDENT LOH ASSASSINATED BY HIS FOLLOWERS; AFFAIR

On the afternoon of August 18
Superintendent Loh Lien-kwei of the Criminal Investigation
Department of the Shanghai Municipal Police, a big leader
of anti-Japanese elements in the International Settlement,
was shot dead by several persons.

At 2.50 p.m. August 18 Superin-

his private motor car No. 743 from his home on Tszepong Road.
Several assassins fired more than ten shots at the Superin-

ambulance, while the chauffeur was sent to the Chinese Lester
Hospital.

Immediately after the assassina-

on August 13.

His chauffeur was also wounded and fell to the ground. The

Hospital.

Immediately after the assassination,
the S.M.P. threw a cordon around the place and started an
investigation. The French Police also adopted precautionary
measures along Avenue Edward VII like those they had adopted
on August 13.

They Had Failed To Carry Out Their Plans On August 13 -
Loh Lien-kwei Took Active Part By Utilizing His
Official Position

of Wushing, Chekiang Province. He was a Superintendent of the

罗巡官被其追随者暗杀：事件笼罩在反日分子的黑色幕帘之下

8月18日下午，上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事侦缉处巡官罗连贵，作为国际租界内反日分子的大头目，被数人枪杀。

8月18日下午2时50分，罗巡官乘坐其私人汽车743号，从资彭路（Tszepang Road）的寓所抵达广东路的中央饭店。当罗巡官正欲下车时，几名刺客向其开枪十余发。罗巡官倒地后，刺客向南朝霍帕路（Hoopah Road）方向逃去。罗巡官胸部被8颗子弹击中，瞬间死亡。其司机亦受伤倒地。罗巡官由工部局救护车运往停尸房，司机则被送往华人莱斯医院。

暗杀发生后，工部局警务处立即在现场周围布置警戒线并开始调查。法租界警方也在爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）采取了类似8月13日那样的预防措施。

Hotel which is a den of anti-Japanese elements; he also
conducted the swimming pool on Bubbling Well Road. Loh Lien-

Among the Chinese employees of the S.M.P. he held one of the
highest positions.

In co-operation with two high

the S.M.C. to maintain an anti-Japanese attitude; on the

The strict precautionary measures

recently relaxed and the public felt somewhat easier. However,
the area at the junction of Canton and Hoopeh Roads was
suddenly thrown into confusion as a result of an incident
at about 3 p.m. August 18, when a Chinese gentleman of about

the Central Hotel, was attacked by two Chinese desperadoes

他与两名警务处高级欧籍官员合作，曾 he 试图促使工部局（S.M.C.）保持反日态度；另一方面，他以中央饭店为总部，在黑色幕帘的掩护下，煽动共产党分子和反日分子实施恐怖行动。毫无疑问，激进分子因其官方影响力和财力而甘愿听从其指令。

正如法租界被暗杀的华籍总探长陆夫（盧 夫）一案那样，据称罗巡官是因8月13日计划失败后，恐怖分子内部发生内讧，而被其 own 追随者所暗杀。

罗连贵遇刺案

与8月13日周年纪念相关的严格预防措施最近已有所放松，公众感到稍许宽慰。然而，8月18日下午3时许，广东路与河北路（Hoopeh Roads）交界处因一起事件突然陷入混乱：一位年约六旬的中国绅士在中央饭店门前正准备进入其汽车时，遭到两名持枪中国歹徒的袭击

- 3 -

armed with pistols. The assassins made their good escape
after firing several shots at the Chinese gentleman.

The Municipal Police immediately
stopped all traffic in the area and made a vigorous search
for the culprits but their efforts were fruitless. The
Chinese gentleman was struck by bullets in the head and chest
and died on the spot, while his chauffeur was wounded on the
right arm. The two men were immediately removed to the
Chinese Lester Hospital.

The victim was found to be
Superintendent Loh Lien-kwei, a leader of the Green Pang
who was supported by a large number of Chinese members of
the Municipal Police Force.

His fortune is estimated at
one million dollars. Thus he was one of the leading
businessmen in the Settlement, owning the Central Hotel,
the Chung Nan Hotel and the swimming pool on Bubbling Well
Road. The murder has caused a considerable sensation in
various quarters.

Assassination May Be Due to Dispute With
Tu Yueh-sung

The late Superintendent Loh
Lien-kwei enjoyed great influence among Chinese members of
the Municipal Police Force. The facts have yet to be disclosed.
However, it is believed that his death is due to a dispute
among members of the Green Pang.

Following the departure of Mr.
Tu Yueh-sung, a leader of the Green Pang, from Shanghai to
Hongkong, Superintendent Loh gradually expanded his influence
and at present his influence is believed to be as great as
that of Mr. Tu. Recently a man named Yang Jin ( ), a right
hand man of Mr. Tu residing in Hongkong, arrived here with
some sinister plans for execution on the occasion of the anniversary

死者经查认为系罗连贵巡官，他是青帮头目，得到工部局警务处大量华籍警员的支持。

其财产估计达一百万元。因此，他是租界内的主要商人之一，拥有中央饭店、中南饭店以及静安寺路的游泳池。这起谋杀案在各界引起了相当大的轰动。

暗杀或因与杜月笙之争所致

已故罗连贵巡官在工部局警务处华籍警员中享有巨大影响力。事实真相尚待披露。然而，据信其死因源于青帮成员内部的纠纷。

继青帮头目杜月笙先生离开上海前往香港后，罗巡官逐渐扩大其影响力，目前据信其影响力已与杜先生相当。近日，一名名叫杨金（Yang Jin ( )）的男子抵达此处，此人是居住在香港的杜先生的得力助手，携有在周年纪念日之际执行的某些邪恶计划

At 2.48 p.m. 18-8-38, a telephone message
was received from D.S.I. Sigerson (Louza) reporting
that Det. Supt. Loh Lien Kwei (陸連奎) had been
shot outside the Central Hotel, Canton Road.

C.I. Chamberlain, D.I. Bennett and all
available men immediately attended, including
personnel of Reserve Unit who were standing by at
Louza Station at the time of the receipt of this
message.

Upon arrival at scene immediate enquiries
ascertained that Supt. Loh Lien Kwei had been shot,
apparently fatal, whilst inside his own car, Lic.
No.743, his chauffeur, one Sung Yeong Sung (孫榮生),
Permit 8126, had been injured, two or three men
responsible for this offence having decamped in an
Easterly direction along Hapeh Road towards the
French Concession.

Both were sent to the Lester Chinese
Hospital by the Shanghai Fire Brigade Ambulance,
whilst members of the Reserve Unit, assisted by
detectives and staff from Louza Station searched
the vicinity, no trace however of the assailants
being found.

Supt. Loh Lien Kwei was pronounced dead
upon arrival at the Lester Hospital, whilst the
Chinese chauffeur, Sung Yeong Sung was found to
be suffering from a bullet wound of the left arm.

Supt. Loh Lien Kwei was attached to Crime
Branch Headquarters, C.I.D. in charge of detectives,

两人均由上海救火会救护车送往莱斯医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），同时后备队成员在侦探及老闸捕房职员的协助下搜查周边地区，但未发现袭击者的踪迹。

陆连奎警司抵达莱斯医院后被宣布死亡，而中国籍司机孙荣生被发现左臂受枪伤。

20 3 38

High Police Officer Killed
Supt. Loh Lien-kwe Assassinated Outside
Chinese Hotel ; Two Gunmen Escape

A PAIR of bold assassins riddled Supt. Loh Lien-kwe, a leading Chinese detective officer of the Settlement Police, with bullets outside the Central Hotel, Canton Road, at 2.45 o'clock yesterday afternoon and then escaped by running into Hoopeh Road. Supt. Loh, who was one of the most influential Chinese in Shanghai, died almost instantly from wounds in the head, chest and shoulder, and was pronounced dead on being admitted to the Lester Hospital. His chauffeur was wounded in the arm, losing a considerable amount of blood, and is now in the Lester Hospital in a serious condition. Pro-Japanese elements are suspected of having perpetrated the daring crime.

It was the first instance in the history of the Municipal Police in which a high-ranking officer had been assassinated, and immediately the news had been flashed to Headquarters a vast machinery was set in motion to bring the assassins to justice. The Louza Station police and two sections of the Headquarters staff were at once assigned to the case and began investigations which took them to various parts of Shanghai.

As soon as the alarm reached Louza Station, at 2.45 p.m., all available men there hurried to the scene as well as the members of the Reserve Unit who were standing-by at the time in Ningpo Road. Station cars filled with steel-clad policemen, and the big red vans of the riot-squad, rushed to the corner of Canton Road and Hoopeh Road, where the assassination had taken place. The immediate neighbourhood was surrounded and a thorough search made of houses and alleyways. The murderers, however, had escaped.

Bodyguard Not Present

Supt. Loh had driven up to the Canton Road entrance of the Central Hotel in his private motor-car. He was without his usual bodyguard. The driver had scarcely stopped the car when the assassins, two in number, opened fire at close range, riddling the vehicle and putting at least six bullets into Supt. Loh. The heavy-set detective officer, still in the rear of the car, slumped to the seat, blood oozing from wounds in his head, chest and one shoulder. His customary cigar dropped from his mouth and fell on to the cushion beside him. He was dead before the light had gone out of the cigar.

The chauffeur, wounded in one arm, staggered out of the car and vainly tried to cross the street for safety. He left a wide trail of blood on the pavement, which was littered with glass from the broken windows and head-lamps of the car.

The assassins, who were believed to be Chinese, escaped by running from Canton Road into crowded Hoopeh Road and mingling with the milling horde. While they were only two in number, it is thought that other members of the same gang were present as look-outs and escaped without difficulty. The shots caused temporary panic in the ranks of traffic and pedestrians, but later hundreds crowded at the spot to stare at the tragic scene.

Many Shots Fired

It was estimated that at least twelve shots were fired from two pistols, one being a high-velocity Mauser and the other an ordinary automatic of .32 calibre. One of the bullets penetrated the side of the hotel.

A lucky man was the hotel attendant who was on the footpath, about to open the door of the car, when the fusillade was let loose. He escaped unhurt, although bullets and broken glass flew about him.

Mr. Loh's body was placed in the mortuary of the Lester Hospital and there an inquest was held by the Chinese Court Procurator yesterday evening in the presence of witnesses, police officials and relatives of the victim. The Procurator's verdict was that Supt. Loh had met death at the hands of persons unknown. The body was taken from the hospital to the parlours of the International Funeral Directors in Kiaochow Road, where it will be encoffined today.

高级警官遇害
罗连贵督察在中央饭店外遭暗杀；两名枪手逃脱

昨天下午2时45分，两名大胆的刺客在广东路中央饭店外，向租界警务处华籍侦探主管罗连贵（Supt. Loh Lien-kwe）督察连开数枪，随后跑入湖北路逃脱。罗督察是上海最具影响力的华人之一，因头部、胸部和肩部中弹，几乎当场死亡，送入雷士德医院（Lester Hospital）后被宣告不治。他的司机手臂受伤，失血过多，目前仍在雷士德医院，情况危急。亲日分子被怀疑策划了这起大胆罪行。

这是工部局警务处历史上首次发生高级警官被暗杀的事件，消息一经传至总部，庞大的追捕机制立即启动，誓将凶手绳之以法。老闸捕房的警员以及总部的两组人员立即被指派负责此案，并展开调查，足迹遍布上海各地。

下午2时45分，警报一传到老闸捕房，该处所有可用警力以及当时在宁波路待命的后备队成员立即赶赴现场。满载着身穿防弹衣警察的警车，以及防暴队的大型红色厢式车，疾驰至案发地——广东路与湖北路的转角。紧邻区域被包围，对房屋和弄堂进行了彻底搜查。然而，凶手已经逃脱。

保镖不在场

罗督察驾驶私人汽车抵达中央饭店的广东路入口。他身边没有像往常一样配备保镖。司机刚停下车，两名刺客便在近距离开火，将车辆打得千疮百孔，至少六颗子弹击中罗督察。这位体格魁梧的侦探官当时仍在车后座，瘫倒在座位上，头部、胸部和一侧肩部的伤口渗出血来。他惯常抽的雪茄从口中掉落，落在身旁的坐垫上。雪茄上的火光尚未熄灭，他便已气绝。

司机一只手臂受伤，踉跄着走出汽车，试图穿过街道寻求安全，但未果。他在人行道上留下了一道宽宽的血迹，地上散落着汽车破碎车窗和前灯留下的玻璃碎片。

据信刺客为华人，他们从广东路跑入拥挤的湖北路，混入慌乱的人群中逃脱。虽然枪手只有两人，但据信同一帮派的其他成员作为望风者也在现场，并轻易逃脱。枪声曾引起交通和行人短暂的恐慌，但随后数百人聚集在现场，围观这一悲剧场景。

多发枪击

据估计，两支手枪至少发射了十二发子弹，其中一支是高速毛瑟枪，另一支是普通的.32口径自动手枪。其中一颗子弹击穿了饭店的侧面墙壁。

一名饭店侍者堪称幸运，当时他正站在人行道上准备打开车门，枪声骤起。尽管子弹和碎玻璃在他周围飞溅，但他毫发无伤。

罗先生的遗体被安置在雷士德医院的停尸房，昨晚在中国法院检察官的主持下，在证人、警务官员和受害者亲属的见证下进行了验尸。检察官的裁决是，罗督察死于不明身份者之手。遗体随后从医院运往胶州路万国殡仪馆（International Funeral Directors），将于今日入殓。

Supt. Loh Lien-kwe was a man
whose place in the Settlement Police
it will be difficult to fill. His long
detective experience, his connections
and his genius in dealing with cases
all contributed to make him an out-
standing figure in the S.M.P. Besides,
his genial character and generous
disposition had endeared him to many
in and outside of police ranks.

Notable Police Career

Supt. Loh rose from humble begin-
nings. He was born in Huchow, Che-
kiang, 49 years ago, and joined the
S.M.P. as a constable on May 27, 1911.
In 1916 he was made a detective con-
stable and he continued in the Detec-
tive Branch until the time of his
death. He was appointed sergeant
in 1923, sub-inspector, in 1926, in-
spector in 1927, chief inspector in
1929, assistant superintendent in 1933,
and superintendent in 1937. His com-
mendations for superior police work
numbered well over 100, and he was
decorated twice by the Council—once
with the Police Long Service Medal,
and recently with the 1937 Emergency
Medal.

Mr. Loh leaves two sons and four
daughters. His wife died last year,
elaborate funeral services being held
in the spring of this year.

Supt. Loh's hospitality was extend-
ed to many, both Chinese and
foreigners, who will remember him
as a genial host and a connoisseur of
the delicacies of the Chinese table.
To those who came into daily contact
with him, he will stand out as a
quiet-natured and even-tempered
man, able to handle difficult problems
with tact and understanding, and al-
ways eager to help those in need of
his assistance. He had friends in all
the Municipal services, the Press and
the Shanghai business world, who will
long cherish his memory.

罗连贵督察在租界警务处的地位难以替代。他长期的侦探经验、广泛的人脉以及处理案件的天赋，都使他成为工部局警务处（S.M.P.）中的杰出人物。此外，他和蔼的性格和慷慨的秉性，使他在警队内外都深受爱戴。

显著的警务生涯

罗督察出身寒微。他于49年前出生于浙江湖州，1911年5月27日以巡捕身份加入工部局警务处。1916年，他升任侦探巡捕，并一直在侦探科任职直至去世。他于1923年升任巡长，1926年升任副督察，1927年升任督察，1929年升任总督察，1933年升任助理总监，1937年升任总监。他因警务工作出色而获得的嘉奖超过100次，并两次获得公局授勋——一次是警务长期服务奖章，最近一次是1937年紧急状态奖章。

罗先生留下两子四女。其妻子去年去世，今年春季举行了隆重的葬礼。

罗督察热情好客，许多华人和外国人都曾受其款待，人们会记得他是一位和蔼的主人，也是中国美食的行家。对于那些与他日常接触的人来说，他是一个性格安静、脾气平和的人，能够以机智和理解力处理棘手问题，并且总是乐于帮助那些需要他援助的人。他在工部局各部门、新闻界和上海商界都有朋友，他们将长久怀念他。

工部局警务处华籍总监
在中央饭店外遭暗杀

罗连贵死在车内，嘴里仍叼着雪茄；枪手向汽车扫射，司机受伤

恐怖分子涉嫌为报复而杀人

在最近国际租界发生的最轰动的暗杀案之一中，工部局警务处总部华籍侦探主管罗连贵总监，于昨天下午2时45分驾车抵达广东路与湖北路交汇处的中央饭店前时，身中数弹。

罗总监胸部和身体多处中弹，瘫倒在车内，但去世时嘴里仍紧咬着雪茄。他的司机手部和肩部受伤，正在雷士德华人医院接受治疗。

实施这起光天化日之下残忍杀戮的两三名枪手，在随后的混乱中混入人群，沿湖北路向法租界方向逃脱，截至昨晚深夜仍在逃。但他们不太可能逍遥法外太久，因为警队中的每一名侦探都发誓要将他们抓获。

警方普遍认为，这起残忍的杀戮被视为恐怖分子对近期逮捕行动的报复，原因是逮捕了许多黄道会（Huang Tao Society，即青帮/安清道友会相关组织）成员，并揭露了其行动内幕。普遍相信，恐怖团伙的头目将这些逮捕归咎于这位被谋杀的警官的组织工作，因此，他于昨天下午“被盯上”并遭杀害。新成立的工部局警务处凶杀组侦探一直追踪该团伙，最近的许多暗杀和恐怖活动都与该团伙有关，其总部设在新亚饭店。

罗总监作为华籍侦探主管，以在华界最可靠、最无情的侦探而闻名。

闪电般的暗杀

这次暗杀和司机受伤的行动执行得如此专业且迅速，以至于在距离案发现场不到25码的湖北路与广东路交汇处执勤的一名华籍巡捕，还没来得及回过神来，一切就结束了，惊恐的人群向四面八方涌去。

昨天下午，罗督察像往常一样驾车来到中央饭店，这也是他的产业之一。除了司机外，车内只有他一人，尽管他经常由一名侦探作为武装保镖陪同。他的生命曾多次受到武装罪犯和其他黑社会分子的威胁，尤其是最近，他收到了大量恐吓信。他的上司总是劝他配备保镖，但他总是对此一笑置之，并尽可能避免让保镖随行。

three men suddenly stepped forward and, before the terrified gaze of many a passer-by and shopkeepers on both sides of the street, they let loose a hail of bullets at the officer sitting inside the car, bullets shattering the plate glass windows and two hitting the driver, who slumped at the wheel.

Almost immediately the whole street was clear and, together with the running crowd, the gunmen managed to make their escape towards the French Concession, without anyone noticing them. Several versions of what actually occurred and how many terrorists there were taking part in the assassination were given to the police, but one and all were sure that there were at least two men and that they wore short jackets.

Eleven Shells Found
Eleven empty cartridge shells were picked up at the scene of the killing. They were immediately examined by ballistic experts of the S.M.P., and nine were found to have been fired from a Mauser pistol and two from a .32 calibre automatic. Ballistic experts stated that only two pistols were used by the gunmen and that the Mauser was very similar to the ones used in recent assassinations and should be of a close serial number.

The smoke of gunfire had not cleared when an alarm was sent through to the Police Headquarters, the Louza Police Station and the Shanghai Fire Brigade for an Emergency Ambulance. While frightened crowds were still running in all directions and taking cover in shops and alleyways, a squad of police from the Louza Police Station arrived on the scene, to be followed almost immediately by the Reserve Unit, who threw a cordon round the area and conducted a search. Members of the Homicide Squad were on the scene within a few minutes in their new Riot Car as well as detectives of the Crime Branch Headquarters, which section the late Superintendent Loh headed.

As the intense search for suspects got under way, with the leading sleuths of the S.M.P. in charge of the investigation, the ace detective's corpse, bleeding profusely from the chest, was picked up from the floor of his car, placed in an ambulance and taken to the Lester Chinese Hospital, where the Superintendent was pronounced dead. There were six bullet holes in his body. The chauffeur was also taken to the Lester Hospital and, later in the evening, he was transferred to the Police Hospital for treatment of wounds to his hand and shoulder.

Shot Into Hotel
A search for cartridge shells and bullet holes unearthed a bullet hole through the iron grille surrounding a confectionary store in the vestibule of the Central Hotel. It is believed that this shot was fired by one of the gunmen at a hotel coolie, who had run up to open the door of Superintendent Loh's car, but had fled back into the hotel as the gunplay started. Another bullet hole was found in the plate glass window of a pharmacy across the street from the Central Hotel.

Not forgetting the minutest details despite the excitement of the moment, the detectives, who were first on the scene, did not overlook to obtain a number of witnesses of the assassination. A number of these were being questioned at the Louza Police Station up to a late hour last night, and it is expected that they may help the police in tracing the killers, whom every detective in the Force has vowed to bring to book.

Loss Mourned
The death of Superintendent Loh cast a gloom over the Force last evening when his passing became known to the hundreds of men with whom he had served since 1911. He joined the Force on May 27 of that year as a constable and worked his way to the position of Superintendent, to which he was promoted on May 1, 1937, before reaching the age of 50. A most genial officer with his men and friends, he also numbered not a few well-wishers among the Chinese criminal world, having frequently lent a helping hand to a young wrongdoer and put him back on the right path.

But among the armed criminal fraternity he was one of the most feared men in the city. Relentless in his pursuit of the armed kidnapper and gun-wielder, Loh Lien-kwei's name was a synonym for danger when he hit the trail of wrongdoers.

Reliable And Loyal
A high officer of the S.M.P. yesterday referred to the late Superintendent Loh as a man of great courage and pointed out that, despite the fact that he had been warned a great number of times, Loh did not want to have a bodyguard always with him. The officer also pointed out that the assassinated man was one of the most outstanding men who had been in the detective branch. He was thoroughly reliable and loyal to the Shanghai community.

In a circular order yesterday, the Commissioner of Police expressed great regret at the sudden death of Superintendent Loh, by which the Force loses one of its most valued officers, and the Commissioner, on behalf of all members of the Force, expressed his deep regret at the death of Superintendent Loh and extended to his relatives an expression of deep sympathy.

The body of the deceased has been taken to the parlours of the International Funeral Directors on Kiaochow Road, and the encoffining ceremony will be held on Sunday. The casket will be temporarily put in the care of the Ping Klang King Tso Cemetery.

The late Mr. Loh is survived by two sons and two daughters.

三名男子突然冲上前，在街道两侧众多惊恐的行人和店主的注视下，向坐在车内的警官倾泻出一阵弹雨，子弹击碎了平板玻璃窗，其中两发击中司机，使其瘫倒在方向盘上。

几乎立刻，整条街道变得空无一人，枪手混在奔逃的人群中，趁无人注意之际向法租界方向逃脱。警方收到了关于实际发生情况以及参与暗杀的恐怖分子人数的多种说法，但所有说法都确信至少有两人，且他们身穿短夹克。

发现十一枚弹壳
在凶案现场拾获了十一枚空弹壳。工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的弹道专家立即进行了检验，发现其中九枚系由毛瑟手枪发射，两枚系由0.32口径自动手枪发射。弹道专家指出，枪手仅使用了两支手枪，且那支毛瑟手枪与近期暗杀案中使用的枪支非常相似，序列号应该相近。

枪烟尚未消散，警报便已传至警察总局、老闸捕房以及上海救火会，请求派遣紧急救护车。当惊恐的人群仍在四处奔逃，躲入商店和弄堂时，老闸捕房的一队警员抵达现场，后备队紧随其后，对该区域实施包围并展开搜查。刑事侦缉股总部的侦探以及凶杀组人员也在几分钟内乘坐新型防暴车抵达现场，该部门由已故督察长罗氏领导。

随着对嫌疑人的严密搜查展开，工部局警务处的首席侦探们负责指挥调查，这位王牌侦探的尸体从其汽车地板上被抬出，胸部大量出血，随后被放入救护车送往莱斯德华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），督察长在那里被宣告死亡。其身中六弹。司机也被送往莱斯德医院，当晚晚些时候，因手部和肩部受伤，他被转至警察医院接受治疗。

射入酒店
在对弹壳和弹孔的搜查中，在中大饭店（Central Hotel）门厅内一家糖果店周围的铁栅栏上发现了一个弹孔。据信，这一枪是其中一名枪手向一名酒店茶房开的，该茶房曾跑上前去打开罗督察长的车门，但在枪战开始后逃回酒店内。在中大饭店对面的一家药房的平板玻璃窗上也发现了另一个弹孔。

尽管当时气氛紧张，首批抵达现场的侦探们并未忽视最细微的细节，他们设法获取了多名暗杀案的目击者。截至昨晚深夜，其中一些人正在老闸捕房接受讯问，预计他们可能协助警方追踪凶手，警队中的每一位侦探都发誓要将凶手绳之以法。

哀悼逝者
昨晚，当罗督察长去世的消息传开后，他的离世给警队蒙上了一层阴影，数百名自1911年以来与他共事的同僚得知了这一消息。他于当年5月27日以巡捕身份加入警队，一步步晋升至督察长职位，并于1937年5月1日获得晋升，当时他未满50岁。他对下属和朋友极为和蔼可亲，在中国犯罪界也有不少支持者，因为他经常向误入歧途的年轻人伸出援手，引导他们走上正途。

但在武装犯罪团伙中，他是上海最令人畏惧的人物之一。罗联贵（Loh Lien-kwei，音译）在追捕武装绑匪和持枪歹徒时毫不留情，一旦他盯上罪犯，他的名字就成了危险的代名词。

可靠且忠诚
工部局警务处的一位高级官员昨日称已故罗督察长是一位极具勇气的人，并指出，尽管他曾多次收到警告，但罗氏不愿让保镖时刻伴随左右。该官员还指出，这位遇刺者是刑事侦缉部门中最杰出的人物之一。他完全值得信赖，并对上海社区忠心耿耿。

警务处处长昨日在一项通令中对罗督察长的突然逝世表示深切遗憾，警队因此失去了一位最宝贵的官员。处长代表全体警队成员对罗督察长的逝世表示深切哀悼，并向其亲属致以深切的慰问。

死者的遗体已被送往胶州路国际殡仪馆（International Funeral Directors），入殓仪式将于周日举行。灵柩将暂时安放在平康公墓（Ping Klang King Tso Cemetery）。

已故罗先生遗有两子两女。
